subject: Bridge lane elevation and pricing splay
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@brightlane.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@brightlane.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Need a short burst lane for Oct 10 campaign — pricing question

Rishi / Ben —

Quick context: we have a promotional push scheduled for Oct 10–12 that will spike inference traffic for our chat assist from ~120k tokens/day to an estimated 1.1M tokens/day for a 48–72 hour window. We’re currently on the Standard 2X quota and will exceed the daily throughput cap if nothing changes.

Can Redwood provide a short-window bridge (3–7 days) and what would the overrun pricing look like? We want options that avoid a surprise invoice later this month — would prefer a provisional uplift + amortized true‑up or a one‑time burst credit.

Attached are a sample of our recent logs and a short projection worksheet. Key asks:
- Maximum provisional uplift you can offer for a 72-hour window
- Blended overrun rate if we take a provisional uplift vs pay-as-you-go overrun
- Whether you can cap total charge to a pre-agreed threshold for the 72h window

We’re open to a short-term uplift with a reconciliation true‑up afterwards. If you can outline the pricing paths by EOD Pacific, we can route to procurement.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Product Operations
BrightLane Health

Attachments: BrightLane_usage_spike_logs.zip (logs + projection.csv)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@brightlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need a short burst lane for Oct 10 campaign — pricing question

Emma — thanks for the details and the attachment, that helps. Quick clarifying Qs before I put numbers together:
- Is the 1.1M/day estimate peak or sustained across the 72h window?
- Do you need any increase to concurrent QPS (rate limits) or only daily quota/throughput?
- Are you expecting a steady ramp or a single-day spike?

Prelim thinking (high level):
- Option A: Provisional uplift (temp 3x quota for up to 7 days) + month-end true‑up. We can do an amortized reconciliation where overrun usage is billed at a blended overrun rate with a one-time credit if you commit to a follow-on min monthly commit.
- Option B: Pay-as-you-go overrun at the published overrun band (no uplift reservation) — simpler but exposure to peak charges.
- Option C: Short-term capped burst: we reserve headroom and cap the charge to a negotiated fixed amount for the window (requires a small upfront authorization).

I’ll run numbers with Ben and loop in Laura for approvals. Plan to get a concrete proposal back to you within 36 hours.

—Rishi
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Need a short burst lane for Oct 10 campaign — pricing question

Rishi / Ben —

Looping in to approve a provisional approach for BrightLane given this is a short commercial campaign and they’ve been a steady net-new ARR motion. Approve we offer a one-week provisional uplift (72–96h window acceptable) using the Bridge Lane playbook with the following constraints:
- Temporary uplift: up to 3x current committed quota for 7 days
- Blended overrun rate: base overrun band price less 30% discount for the uplifted portion (this is a commercial concession)
- Cap option: offer a capped total exposure option at the blended rate + $X authorization (we’ll finalize $X with Ben)
- Finance: reconcile with a month-end true‑up; any credits applied against next invoice.

Ben — please draft the provisional amendment and an option that includes a capped‑charge fallback. Aim for a short addendum PDF we can send to them today. Rishi — you can lead customer comms.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Commercial Sales Operations
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@brightlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: 72h provisional uplift + amortized true-up (BrightLane)

Emma —

Thanks for the patience. Per internal approval, here are the two options we can execute quickly. I’ve attached a short provisional SLA amendment (draft) for the uplift path.

Summary (numbers are illustrative; final amendment will show exact $ amounts):
Option 1 — Bridge uplift (recommended):
- Uplift: 3x current quota applied for a 72‑hour window starting on Oct 10 00:00 PDT
- Pricing for uplifted usage: blended overrun rate of $0.018 per 1k tokens (equivalent units used on your account), which already nets a 30% commercial concession off published overrun bands for the uplifted portion
- Cap option: we can limit total charge for the 72h window to $12,000 if you select the capped fallback (requires pre-authorization of the cap amount)
- True-up: Usage will be reconciled at month-end; any difference will be invoiced (or credited) and amortized across the Oct invoice.

Option 2 — Pay-as-you-go overrun (no reservation):
- Usage billed at published overrun bands (no uplift reservation). Simpler but no protective cap; not discounted.

Next steps:
1) If you accept Option 1 we’ll send the provisional_sla_amendment_draft.pdf for countersign (DocuSign link included below).
2) If you prefer the cap, confirm the cap amount and we’ll add the authorization line to the addendum.
3) We’ll enable the headroom in our routing system the day before the window and run a verification test.

Attachments: provisional_sla_amendment_draft.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPE123456789
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If it helps, we can also set a temporary rate-limit backfill to smooth downstream ingestion — happy to coordinate with your infra lead.

—Rishi
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma.li@brightlane.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@brightlane.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 72h provisional uplift + amortized true-up (BrightLane)

Thanks, Rishi — this looks good and appreciated the quick turn. We’ll take Option 1 with the $12,000 cap (please add the authorization line). Two quick Qs:
1) Can you confirm whether the uplift will increase concurrent QPS limits as well, or only daily token quota? Our infra may hit rate-limit throttles first.
2) For the month-end true‑up, will the blended overrun be itemized separately on the invoice? We need that for our cost center routing.

We’ll countersign the DocuSign within 24 hours once the cap is in the amendment.

Emma
Head of Product Operations, BrightLane Health
